evidence.label: authentication_model
evidence.detail: stdio transport: the client launches the server as a subprocess, so the OS process boundary is the auth boundary — `03` §4 does not penalise absent auth here

evidence.label: transport_security
evidence.detail: declared transport: stdio — launched as a subprocess by the client, so the security boundary is the client process, not a network port (`03` §4)

evidence.label: secret_handling
evidence.detail: detect-secrets matched 101 credential-shaped string(s), every one from a keyword or entropy heuristic (Base64 High Entropy String, Hex High Entropy String, Secret Keyword). Those flag placeholders, variable names and content hashes as readily as credentials, so they do not establish the committed credential `03` §4's 0 asserts, and this sub-check is not scored; Secret Keyword at dist/cli-cmds.mjs:12063; Secret Keyword at dist/cli-cmds.mjs:12064; Secret Keyword at dist/cli-cmds.mjs:12494; Secret Keyword at dist/cli-cmds.mjs:13168; Hex High Entropy String at dist/cli-cmds.mjs:37665; Hex High Entropy String at dist/cli-cmds.mjs:48978; Hex High Entropy String at dist/cli-cmds.mjs:48979; Hex High Entropy String at dist/cli-cmds.mjs:48985; Hex High Entropy String at dist/cli-cmds.mjs:48986; Hex High Entropy String at dist/cli-cmds.mjs:48987; …and 91 more matches
